_README: Registry for lint_consistency.py — the machine half of CLAUDE.md's ONE-FACT-ONE-PLACE rule.
WHY IT EXISTS. On 2026-07-25 a cleanup of STRATEGY.md found the SAME quantity stated at three
different values in one file, a high band that did not sum, a dependency spine whose cumulative
chain disagreed with the ladder it summarised, and a rung recorded as both UNPRICED and PRICED.
Every one of those was a number that lived in several places while a correction reached one of
them. Prose discipline had already been tried and had already failed — which is the same reason
lint_claims.py exists. So the discipline is enforced here instead.
TWO KINDS OF ENTRY, because there are two distinct failure modes:
derivations[] — a total that must EQUAL its parts. Catches a wrong CURRENT value (the $544
high band that did not sum; the $128 that came from a table missing a row).
superseded[]  — a value that has been replaced. It may still appear (this repo never silently
drops a correction) but ONLY on a line that marks it as superseded. Catches an
OLD value surviving somewhere the fix did not reach.
ADDING AN ENTRY IS PART OF MAKING THE CORRECTION, not extra work afterwards: when you change a
pinned number, add its old value here in the same commit. CI then finds every copy you missed.
KEEP PATTERNS TIGHT. A linter that flags true statements gets ignored, which is worse than no
linter (lint_claims.py's founding lesson). Prefer a multi-token pattern over a bare number.
_marker_note: A superseded value is CLEARED when its line — or the two lines above / one below, because markdown prose
wraps mid-sentence — carries one of these, or when the enclosing heading does, or when the value is
★ A MARKER MUST MEAN 'THIS VALUE IS NO LONGER CURRENT'. It must NOT merely mean 'something changed here'.
This list once contained 'REPRICED', 'corrected', 'wrong' and 'refuted' — and an adversarial test on
2026-07-25 showed that a reintroduced '★ REPRICED → ~$128 mid-range' CLEARED ITSELF, i.e. the linter would
have missed the exact bug it was written for. A reprice ASSERTS a new value; it disclaims nothing.
Before adding a marker, ask: could this word appear in a sentence that states the number as CURRENT? If
yes, it is not a marker.

derivations.description: The gated-ladder total must equal the machine repricing plus the stages that tool does not cover. It is a DERIVED figure and must never be typed by hand.
derivations._non_tool_note: [low, mid, high]. valA_mini's mid is its REALIZED ~$0 on GCP credit, not the midpoint of its 0-15 band; step0 uses the midpoint of 1-2.
derivations._must_appear_in_note: CLAUDE.md was on this list and was REMOVED 2026-07-25. Requiring it there forced a fourth copy of a number whose home is STRATEGY.md -- the exact thing the one-fact-one-place rule forbids, and CLAUDE.md's copy had in fact been stale three times running (~$390 -> ~$240 -> ~$194). CLAUDE.md now points at STRATEGY.md instead. Only docs that genuinely need to STATE the total belong here.

superseded.retired_by: AMENDMENT 2 (2026-07-25): the A1 input-admissibility check resolved the NEAREST of the construct's six cysteines, which is C566, not the preregistered site C551 (residue offset 344). The superseded figures made the input look NEARLY admissible — ~9 Å against an 8 Å limit — while the real site sat ~28 Å away, so the correction makes A1 MORE binding, not less. The same root cause also built the covalent restraint onto C566 and made the cov_c551a control mutate C566, i.e. not touch C551 at all.

superseded.retired_by: An overclaim in the NEGATIVE direction, withdrawn 2026-07-25 from main-text Limitations caveat 5 and SI S2. The co-folding classifier fails its own affinity-sensitive stereochemical control (an inactive epimer scored identically to the active construct), and the paper therefore declares it unsuitable for binding, ternary-stability, degradation-selectivity or linker-ranking claims — so it may not conclude ternary selectivity is ABSENT either. What the run supports is absence of evidence at a tier that cannot produce the evidence.

subset_checks.description: STRATEGY.md's dependency spine restates the ordered plan's cumulative chain. On 2026-07-25 it carried $15/$97/$273/$252 against the ladder's $13/$48/$104/$194. Subset, not equality — the spine legitimately skips rungs it does not draw.
